# The portal's fixture

The three repositories in miniature, which `pnpm test`, CI and `pnpm docs:browser` build with
`--from fixture`: no network, no sibling checkout. Each `release.json` is the release the build
names for that section (`v1.11.0` for Diagrams, `v0.2.29` for the IDE, `main` for this
repository). Every rule of the conversion has a page here; the failures (a page without a heading,
a link to a page that does not exist) are written by the tests on copies of these trees, since the
fixture itself must build.

| Page                                                        | What it exercises                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `diagrams/docs/README.md`, `diagrams/docs/es/README.md`     | The index in both languages: its `##` headings become the sidebar's groups (named in both languages), its links the order; `getting-started.md`, `features.md` and `language/stories.md` are linked, `cli.md` and `player.md` not                                                                       |
| `diagrams/docs/getting-started.md`, `features.md` and twins | Plain guides with a twin link on their first line, which is dropped                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `diagrams/docs/cli.md`                                      | A guide in English only: the Spanish locale gets the notice page "Esta guía sólo existe en inglés."                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `diagrams/docs/player.md`                                   | The links of the conversion: a page with an anchor (`language/stories.md#exports`), a file outside `docs/` (`../CHANGELOG.md`), a medium (`media/editing-demo.gif`), a reference definition, an HTML link, a badge from another host (written as its words), and links inside code that stay as written |
| `diagrams/docs/es/player.md`                                | The Spanish twin: its anchor (`#exportaciones`) and the shared medium reached from `es/`                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `diagrams/docs/language/stories.md`                         | Three `text` fences: the purchase story's whole source (drawn into a picture with the `client` and `api` boxes), the fragment `reveal client, api over 800ms` and a sentence (both stay code); the Exports section Ask answers from                                                                     |
| `diagrams/docs/es/language/stories.md`                      | A twin in a folder, with no fence                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `diagrams/docs/media/editing-demo.gif`                      | The medium copied into the build (a 43-byte GIF)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `ide/README.md`, `ide/LEEME.md`                             | No `docs/README.md`: the repository's readmes are the section's index in each language, after an SPDX comment; a CI badge from another host                                                                                                                                                             |
| `ide/docs/quickstart.md`                                    | A guide in Spanish only, in a repository with no `docs/es/` (its language read from its words): `/es/ide/quickstart/` holds it, `/ide/quickstart/` the notice "This guide exists in Spanish only."                                                                                                      |
| `ide/docs/local-models.md`                                  | A guide in English only in the same repository                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `web/README.md`, `web/docs/repositories.md`                 | This repository's section: the readme as index, a table, a link to a folder with no readme (GitHub's tree at the ref)                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `web/docs/decisions/0001-family-repositories.md`            | A page in a folder the index does not link: a folded group "Decisions"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
